Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] '''''Remoh''''' was sent to assist the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] group ''[[Geedon]]'' with a complement of [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] at its disposal. However, it arrived too late to save the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] group.
